title: E-values in the browser: validation of the allmeta E-value page against the R package EValue (reproducibility archive)
description: Reproducibility archive for the allmeta E-value page (allmeta <ALLMETA_RELEASE>; release DOI <ALLMETA_RELEASE_DOI>). The page's own scripts were compared with EValue 4.1.4 (R 4.6.0) on 3,738 preregistered configurations (2,413 from 30 metadat datasets, 1,325 synthetic): 22,428/22,428 checks within 1e-9; planted defects rejected. Run: Rscript --vanilla validate.R.
